why_this_action:
Actor npc_b is at (9.5, 110, -0.5) with an empty inventory. The episode goal is to craft and retain one wooden pickaxe. The first prerequisite is obtaining logs, because logs can be turned into planks, sticks, a crafting table, and then a wooden pickaxe. The current world scan has verified oak_log blocks within the loaded cache: (9, 112, -10) at distance 9.72 and (9, 113, -10) at distance 9.97. No planks, sticks, crafting table, or pickaxe are present in inventory, so crafting cannot begin yet. Immediate nearby blocks are grass, dirt, and short grass, which do not advance the pickaxe recipe. Collecting logs is therefore the earliest physical step that can create inventory progress.

Collect Logs is the visible direct primitive specifically intended to gather reachable log blocks and produce inventory evidence. It is the correct first physical action from an empty inventory when the loaded world contains oak_log blocks. Crafting planks, sticks, or a crafting table is not yet possible because the inventory is empty. Moving first would only be preferable if log collection fails due to reachability; attempting collection directly can create immediate inventory progress if the runtime can path to the verified logs.
expected_evidence: Post-action inventory_delta evidence shows oak_log, minecraft:oak_log, or equivalent log item count >= 1 in npc_b inventory.
Runtime inventory snapshot no longer shows empty inventory and contains at least one log item.
Optional supporting world_block_delta evidence shows one or more oak_log blocks near (9, 112, -10) or (9, 113, -10) were removed or changed.
fallback_if_blocked: If runtime evidence shows no log was added to inventory, treat this as a reachability or target-selection blocker. Next, move north about 9 blocks toward the verified oak_log near (9, 112, -10), then retry Collect Logs or use Mine Block on oak_log if a specific reachable log remains visible. If no logs can be obtained from these positions, record the blocker and look for alternative wood sources or mine nearby oak_planks blocks only as a fallback to obtain initial planks.
